build_MLPNet: build an MLPNet model for CIFAR-10 classification using the configured transformation function and layer depth
create_LinearTransform: create a LinearTransform module with a linear layer, batch norm, and ReLU for MLP stages
create_TalkLinearTransform: create a TalkLinearTransform module using relational graph-based linear transformation with configurable message passing
create_MLPStage: create an MLPStage with multiple transformation blocks using the configured transformation function type
get_trans_fun: get a transformation function class by name from the supported transform registry
